project.name: ForwardMeasure Data Streaming Launcher Application
project.description:
Framework-agnostic orchestration for the async REST launcher, in both its real forms (2026-09-13): DirectIngestionLauncher runs an IngestionSpec as one real K8s Job, bypassing fowf's workflow engine entirely, by delegating to openworkflow-kubernetes-job-lifecycle - the same library fowf's own AsyncApiKubernetesJobOperationExecutor uses. WorkflowIngestionLauncher instead starts a real fowf workflow execution through fowf's own generated ExecutionsApi client SDK (POST /v1/executions) - Kubernetes specifics live entirely in that workflow's own definition, never touched here. Direct mode's own scope boundary (pekko engine only, not yet spark - see DirectIngestionLauncher's own javadoc) is real and documented, not silently gapped.
Deliberately depends on nothing framework-specific (no JAX-RS, no CDI) - matching DossierApplicationService's own shape (manifesto Principle 7): this is the layer a REST resource calls into, not the layer that knows it's being called over HTTP at all. Neither launcher builds or configures its own KubernetesClient/ExecutionsApi/ApiClient - how a caller authenticates (Kubernetes client config, fowf bearer-token acquisition) is an environment-specific decision that belongs to whichever framework binding constructs these classes, not to this framework-agnostic module.
